title: Lazy River/ separate from the water park by the beach
content: Sometimes I go to this lazy River, the current is strong, and it’s separate from the water park on the pier by the beach and the bar… I usually remember driving through mountains and forests on endless roads before I get here, There are always people around and floating, I am always told I need to get out of the water and on one of the islands . The water is more swampy and darker than in the photos and instead of sand on the islands it’s more dirt/ mud and darker .
